title: Welcome Back from The FOA
summary: A start-of-year introduction to The FOA, fundraising and key dates.

sections.title: Dear Parents and Carers,
paragraphs: Welcome back! We hope you have all had a wonderful summer and are feeling refreshed, rested and ready for another brilliant year at Ashley.
As the new school year gets underway, we wanted to say a big hello from The Friends of Ashley (FOA) Committee, remind you who we are and what we do, and share some important dates for your diaries.

sections.title: A brilliant year behind us
paragraphs: The FOA plays a huge part in bringing our community together, supporting the school and creating extra special experiences and opportunities for our children.
After an incredible year, including reaching the £21,000 playground fundraising target and raising £25,730, we are very excited about what we can achieve together this year.

sections.title: The Friends of Ashley: your school PTA
paragraphs: Every parent, carer and teacher at Ashley is considered a member of the PTA. The FOA is supported and overseen by a committee of parent volunteers, elected at the Annual General Meeting.
The committee helps to organise fundraising, coordinate events, oversee The FOA's finances and make decisions about how our funds can best support the school and its children.

sections.title: Ways to get involved
paragraphs: You do not need to be on the committee to be part of the FOA. You might help at an event, lend a hand with pre-loved uniform, share an idea, volunteer for an hour or two, or take charge of a seasonal event such as the Christmas Fayre or Summer fete.
Just coming along and showing your support really makes a difference.
